original.question: John has 10 hectares of pineapple field. There are 100 pineapples per hectare. John can harvest his pineapples every 3 months. How many pineapples can John harvest within a year?
original.answer:
John has 100*10= <<100*10=1000>>1000 pineapples on his field.
John can harvest his pineapples 12 / 3 = <<12/3=4>>4 times per year
Therefore John can harvest 1000*4 = <<1000*4=4000>>4000 pineapples per year.
#### 4000
